note: P4131 (Pro 20:8) — a king on the throne of judgment winnows all evil with his eyes. (ra 'evil' = standalone.)

dims.v: discernment — the king's judgment that sifts out evil
the judging/discernment by which a king on his throne winnows out all evil with his eyes
the discerning royal gaze that separates evil from good

din (judgment/justice) — 'a king who sits on the throne of JUDGMENT winnows all evil with his eyes'; the just king's discerning gaze sifts and scatters evil. Emergent: judgment as the discerning power that separates evil out — the ideal of the seeing, sifting ruler.
